UI_NE_Start_1: ...I seem to have been unconscious. ...My body feels strangely hot, like it's burning.
UI_NE_Start_2: ...I recognize this corpse. ...Is it Dr. Hiro, the researcher who treated me as a test subject?
UI_NE_Start_3: (...Cough! Hack!!)...I suffered a deep wound to my throat when I pulled out that mysterious IV!
UI_NE_Start_4: I was supposed to be transferred out of state from the airport. ...So why am I in a place like this?
UI_NE_Start_5: ...To investigate this abnormality in my body, I have no choice but to go to the military research facility where I was experimented on. If I check this lab coat, will I find a clue?
UI_NE_Card_Reminder: ...I must not. I have to check Dr. Hiro's lab coat...
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Dist: The doctor's body should have the door key and documents. I must go back and look...
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Wake: I had a dream about that doctor... I feel like I must go back to recover the key and documents.
UI_NE_Phase_2: ...Something began to tremble deep inside my body (Phase: Omen)
UI_NE_Phase_3: The world is creaking. There's no turning back (Phase: Collapse)
UI_NE_Phase_4: The bells of doom are ringing. It is time for judgment (Phase: Judgment Day)
UI_Sandbox_DaysToAirstrike_tooltip: Days until the military airstrike (game end). This is the basis for calculating phase transitions.
UI_Sandbox_InstinctVoice_tooltip: Sets whether to allow text display of the character's internal thoughts.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_0: The air tastes good. I feel like I'm coming back to life.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_25: I taste something unpleasant... like metal...
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_50: My throat is burning. My chest... my lungs won't move... *Cough!*
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_75: My vision is growing dark... death is near.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_100: I'm dying, my lungs are disappearing. I have to wash now!
UI_NE_Instinct_Day5: I can't stop coughing. There must be something in that 'western facility' the doctor mentioned. I'll prepare for that day.
UI_NE_Instinct_Day10: Every joint in my body is hot. But I feel like I'm perceiving the world more closely than before...
UI_NE_Instinct_Day15: My flesh is being remade from within. Am I still human?
UI_NE_Instinct_Day20: I hear a voice... Is someone calling me from the far west?
UI_NE_Instinct_Day25: The virus is stroking my brain. Fear is gone, leaving only hunger in its place.
UI_NE_Instinct_Day30: My thoughts are like they're being scorched. The virus's screams are accelerating.
UI_NE_Instinct_Day35: The green in my vision no longer looks like contamination, but the glow of life itself... No, I must...
UI_NE_Instinct_Day40: There's no going back now. With this power, I will reach the deepest part...
UI_NE_Instinct_Day45: My lungs are trembling with joy. Death and life are melting together equally within this body.
UI_NE_Instinct_Day50: It's the limit. Today, everything ends. I'm heading to the research facility's basement to settle this.
UI_NE_Instinct_Key: The nucleus feels familiar to my body... My lost memories are slowly returning.
UI_NE_HiroReminderCount_5: (I don't think I have any more time to look back at him. I must move forward...)
